correctness.rationale: The theorem consistently excludes the order-preserving identity (a unit cannot be generated by singular maps). Top-rank e_{j,k} multiplication preserves rank n-1 iff missing value k lies in the next adjacent collapsed pair, yielding directed reachability. The compressed graph arcs have lengths one/two with intervening arcs, so its sink strong components are intervals, and the four local cut/in/out conditions are sufficient as well as necessary. The boundary-constrained omitted-generator clauses are encoded in an exact 16-state max-plus transfer. I reconstructed the transition matrix and verified every entry of T^9=T^4+4 exactly; associativity proves its five-step recurrence for all exponents. Independent exhaustive generation closure on all subsets for n=4..8 gives ranks 4,6,6,8,9; base cases through n=12 and recurrence give floor(6n/5)-1_{n mod 5=1}. The ten explicitly selected n=9 generators are consistent with the graph criterion. This is not an inference of an infinite theorem from finite examples.
